_doc: Mutable campaign state. The driver reads it to decide whether to start a cycle; the cycle updates it at the end. A fresh session with no context can resume the campaign from this file alone.
last_cycle_outcome: P02 KEEP - protocol amendment: the screen's seed count is now a property of the variant (1 seed on both primaries for variants that never draw from `seed`, 3 otherwise, mouse always 3). Screen cost 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. No algorithm, no champion, sota.json untouched.

history.note: Port MacBook/MPS -> Windows/RTX 4060 (CUDA). 12 runs, 3 seeds x (H35 connectome, H30 microns, H30 mouse, H35 mouse). All champions re-measured; every seed bit-identical (sigma = 0). Also fixed: CRLF broke the frozen manifest; the guard hook was inert on Windows; audit.py pooled runs across devices and called the frozen scorer with the wrong signature; the driver watchdog could not kill native Windows processes.

Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). So the screen now runs 1 seed on the primaries for deterministic variants: 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. Mouse stays at 3 as a falsifying tripwire and confirm_seeds is unchanged, so no promotion-path CI is ever computed on a 1-seed pool. Made operative by seed_plan.py + `sweep.sh --auto-seeds`, pinned by tests/test_seed_plan.py. Corrected the prior analysis's circular claim that protocol_se was unchanged (it is comparator-only by construction; the honest widening at n=1 is +41.4%). Filed P03 after observing an overlapping cycle handoff.

machine: Windows 10 laptop, NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (CUDA), Git Bash
notes: P01 + P02 done 2026-08-09. Three things a resuming session must know. (1) SEED POLICY (P02): the screen's seed count is per variant, not a constant - run `python autoresearch/seed_plan.py --variant <id> --role implement` and launch with `bash autoresearch/sweep.sh --exp <id> --role implement --auto-seeds`. Deterministic variants (H02/H16/H19/H30/H35 today) screen at 1 seed on connectome and microns; everything else at 3; mouse always 3, and if its 3 runs disagree for a deterministic-classified variant the primary numbers are VOID. confirm_seeds is unchanged. Rule: PROTOCOL.md § Phase-7.4; config: campaign.yaml seed_policy. (2) These pipelines take a seed but never draw from it, so sigma = 0 and a Welch CI built on those seeds is degenerate (SE = 0). A verdict needs delta > screen_delta_pp AND the floored PROTOCOL CI; audit.py emits significance.<ds>.degenerate when this applies. (3) microns costs ~3230 s/run here (706 s on MPS); max_cycle_wall_clock_h stays 10 because an rng-classified variant still needs ~8.5 h to confirm. IF THIS CHECKOUT IS MOVED AGAIN: set hardware_rebaseline_done=false, set seed_policy.device_determinism_verified.* to false and restore 3 seeds there, update `machine` and environment.device_tag, and re-run P01 - sota.json is machine-specific (see autoresearch/PORTING.md, incl. § 6b).
